source: Conversations with the program of a Nokia 3310 (Snake II), recorded by running the real program in an emulator with a bot that plays it. msgs = messages sent after the start message (1 tick, 0 timer, 4/5/10..18/20/22 keys); out[0] = state after the start message, out[i+1] = state after msgs[i]; state = [return code, delay ms, timer ms, event code, score, CRC-32 of the 84x48 picture (numpy.packbits order)]. Numbers only - nothing of the program itself.
